<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Complaint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Complaint decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Refund" name="Refund"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organization" name="Organization" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="File complaint" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Start_ComplaintReceived" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Notify decision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Issue refund" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provide feedback" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Participant_Organization" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Handle complaint" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ComplaintReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InvestigationTeam" name="Investigation team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssessComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ComplaintResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FinancialTeam" name="Financial team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ComplaintReceived" name="Complaint received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDetails" name="Review complaint details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessComplaint" name="Assess complaint validity and refund justification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer of decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundSplit" name="Refund approved?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundMerge" name="Continue after decision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintResolved" name="Complaint resolved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_Log" sourceRef="Start_ComplaintReceived" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Log_Assign" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assign_Review" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Assess" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDetails" targetRef="Task_AssessComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Notify" sourceRef="Task_AssessComplaint" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Split" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_RefundSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundSplit" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundSplit" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not refundApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Resolved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resolved_End" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="End_ComplaintResolved"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer complaint and feedback" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_FileComplaint" name="File complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive decision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerRefundSplit" name="Refund approved?"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRefund" name="Receive refund" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge" name="Continue after decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" name="Provide feedback?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide satisfaction feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerNoFeedback" name="No feedback provided"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerFeedback" name="Feedback provided"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStart_File" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_FileComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_File_ReceiveDecision" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDecision_Split" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerRejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundSplit" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not refundApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveRefund_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerMerge_FeedbackChoice" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackProvided" name="Feedback provided" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackProvided}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFeedback" name="No feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="End_CustomerNoFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="End_CustomerFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
